frozen_target.question: Can the exact Round-168 signed two-height integral be proved at L^(3/2)X^epsilon by expanding G exactly and applying the zeta and chi_4 functional equations jointly before every positive norm, or where is the first exact coefficient, gamma, transform, spectral, endpoint, restored-power, or self-return obstruction?

quantities: G(s_1,s_2)=sum g(a,b)a^(-s_1)b^(-s_2) must be derived prime by prime, including G_2=1-2^(-2s_2).
Both GL(1) functional equations must retain their exact conductor, parity, root number, gamma quotient, pole, contour direction, and transformed weight.
The dual coefficient sum must stay one signed aggregate over the G coefficients and both dual variables until its joint phase is exposed.
The favorable smooth radial band has length JL and scale L^(2eta)sqrt(L/J); the missing gain over named absolute placements is sqrt(J).
The exact cardinal transform has O(L^2) unit cells and cannot be replaced by the favorable smooth model without a proved endpoint-lawful identity and quantified corrections.

Any spectral, Kuznetsov, shifted-convolution, or reciprocity theorem must be audited at the exact coefficient class, moduli, lengths, weights, exceptional spectrum, main terms, and absolute-value placement.
Any return to the Round-162 product collar must be coefficientwise and include p=2, gamma/main terms, profiles, endpoints, and errors.
A full t=1 result still leaves every other hard-TOP channel, BAL, UNBAL, M1, endpoint uniformity, M9, bridges, and exponents separate.
